title: Thank You - CDS
before:
Within three business days of receiving this referral, the Child Development Services regional site serving the town in which the child resides will contact the parent/guardian to gather more information, discuss concerns, provide information about CDS, determine the family’s interest, and schedule an appointment. Thank you for contacting CDS.

If you have any questions, please contact CDSReferral.doe@maine.gov or call 877-770-8883.

decisions.label: Make a loose address look like an address
decisions.why: 1 email address sits in the body of this page rather than in a contact block, drawn exactly like every other link — so the one that opens a mail window looks the same as the ones that go to web pages. The chip carries the same envelope the banner's contact link uses. The address itself does not change.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
decisions.value: Within three business days of receiving this referral, the Child Development Services regional site serving the town in which the child resides will contact the parent/guardian to gather more information, discuss concerns, provide information about CDS, determine the family’s interest, and schedule an appointment. Thank you for contacting CDS.

decisions.label: Draw the contact sentence as a contact block
decisions.why: The page carries a sentence whose whole job is to say who to ask, set as body text at the top where it is read before anything it could answer. Drawn as the site's contact block at the foot it sits where a reader looks for it, and the banner gains the Contact chip that jumps to it. The sentence and its link are unchanged.
